Identify Malignant cells with cluster info

cna_classify_cells_with_cluster.Rd

Identify Malignant cells by cna signal and cna correlation with cluster info

Usage

cna_classify_cells_with_cluster(
  cna_scores,
  clusters = NULL,
  signal_threshold = 0.05,
  correlation_threshold = 0.05,
  min_cluster_cc_freq = 0.5,
  cna_matrix = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

cna_scores

cna scores info get from cna_compute_scores or cna_classify_cells

clusters

a named vector of cell clusters with cell id, this must be supplied

signal_threshold

The threshold of cna scores, this is used when cna_scores have no malignant info

correlation_threshold

The threshold of cna correlation, this is used when cna_scores have no malignant info

min_cluster_cc_freq

The minium cancer cell or normal cell precent in a cluster, Default 0.5

cna_matrix

The copy number matrix

verbose

print progress messages. Default: FALSE

Value

return A tibble with Malignant column show the cell type info

See also

cna_compute_scores cna_classify_cells
